definitions.gloss: latter period, second half, late stage
definitions.explanation: The later portion of a time period, era, or process. Used in academic, historical, and scheduling contexts to refer to the second half of a divided period.

examples.japanese: {後期|こうき}の{授業|じゅぎょう}は{十月|じゅうがつ}から{始|はじ}まる。
{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}{後期|こうき}に{文化|ぶんか}が{栄|さか}えた。
examples.english: Culture flourished in the late Edo period.

examples.japanese: {妊娠|にんしん}{後期|こうき}に{入|はい}ると、{体|からだ}への{負担|ふたん}が{大|おお}きくなる。
examples.english: Once you enter the late stage of pregnancy, the physical burden increases.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly paired with {前期|ぜんき} (first half/early period). In universities, {前期|ぜんき}/{後期|こうき} often correspond to the first and second semesters. In historical writing, it marks the later portion of an era.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後期|こうき}{課程|かてい}: latter-stage course
- {後期|こうき}{試験|しけん}: second-semester exam
- {後期|こうき}{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}: person aged 75 or older (official term)
- 〜{時代|じだい}{後期|こうき}: the late ... period
